mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in 3 months signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 3 months does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in 2 months signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% in 2 months does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal (RSAFS increases & UNRATE decreases) does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% in 1 quarter does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
